name: impact-analysis
description: Understand a requested change well enough to make safe workflow decisions, and persist IMPACT_ANALYSIS.md: blast radius, contract, schema and runtime risks. Use when a task is new or partly understood, or a change may touch contracts, schema, integrations, runtime, or critical user flows. Do not use if a valid one exists, to only sync memory, for an observed failure (use incident-triage), or to implement (use implement-approved-slice). Greenfield: backend-system-design, frontend-architecture-review, ai-feature-eval-harness, code-context-map.
